name: TribesPad
notes: TribesPad owns its release recipe. Both games are built by default: the build downloads the free official Tribes 2 installer, the TribesNEXT client and PlayT1's Starsiege: Tribes 1.41 installer, and checks them by SHA-256, so there is no game file to select. Personal builds contain translated game code and the game data and are never published. iPhone and iPad builds without a Mac: Actions → Build TribesPad for iPhone and iPad in a fork of the repository.

commands: brew install llvm@20 cmake ninja sevenzip zstd

steps: Open TribesPad and choose Starsiege: Tribes or Tribes 2 from the game picker. Both games are already inside. Tap the controller button to show touch controls.

For Tribes 2, sign in with your TribesNEXT account (CREATE NEW ACCOUNT makes a free one), then PLAY GAME → JOIN lists the internet servers. You join as an observer: press Fire (RT on a controller) to join a team. To start offline, turn off Settings → Online Play in the ··· menu, then choose LAN GAME → HOST, enable bots and start a match.

For Starsiege: Tribes, choose TRAINING for bots or HOST MULTIPLAYER for a local game. JOIN lists community servers; ··· → Play Online shows who is playing. Use ··· → Choose Game… and reopen TribesPad to return to the picker.
